paragraphs.en: It was around half past one when the two boats from the HISPANIOLA landed. The captain, the squire, and I were discussing our situation in the cabin. Without wind, we could have attacked the six mutineers left on board, slipped our cable, and sailed away.
paragraphs.zh: 大约一点半的时候，来自“西班牙人号”的两艘小艇靠岸了。我们在船舱里讨论着当前的处境。没有风的情况下，我们本可以攻击船上留下的六个叛变者，松开缆绳，扬帆远航。

paragraphs.en: However, the lack of wind made us helpless.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，缺乏风力让我们束手无策。

paragraphs.en: Hunter arrived with news that Jim Hawkins had escaped to shore with the others. We were worried about his safety but did not doubt him. We rushed onto the deck, where the foul smell of fever and dysentery was overwhelming.
paragraphs.zh: 猎人带来了消息，吉姆·霍金斯和其他人一起逃到了岸上。我们为他的安全担忧，但并不怀疑他的话。我们急忙上了甲板，那里弥漫着疟疾和痢疾的难闻气味，令人难以忍受。

paragraphs.en: The six mutineers were grumbling under a sail in the forecastle; onshore, we saw two gigs tied up near the river entrance.
paragraphs.zh: 六个叛乱者在船首甲板下抱怨着；岸上，我们看到两艘划艇拴在河口附近。

paragraphs.en: Hunter and I decided to go ashore in the jolly-boat for information. We pulled straight towards the stockade marked on our chart. Two men guarding their boats seemed agitated by our arrival; "Lillibullero" stopped playing as they discussed what to do next.
paragraphs.zh: 亨特和我决定乘着小划子上岸打听消息。我们直接朝地图中标注的木栅方向驶去。两名看守船只的男子显然对我们到来感到不安；“利利布尔罗”停止了演奏，他们开始商量下一步该怎么办。

paragraphs.en: They likely had orders not to alert Silver, so they stayed put.
paragraphs.zh: 他们大概接到指示不要惊动Silver，所以原地守着。

paragraphs.en: We approached a slight bend in the coast and steered around it, losing sight of the gigs before landing. I jumped out, running quickly with a handkerchief under my hat for coolness and two primed pistols at the ready.
paragraphs.zh: 我们来到海岸的一个轻微弯道前，绕了过去，失去了划艇的视线，随后停了下来。我跳下船，迅速地跑向岸边，头顶戴着手帕以求凉快，并且两手各握着一把上膛的手枪。

paragraphs.en: The spring at the top of the knoll caught my attention. Unlike our cabin on the HISPANIOLA, which had plenty of supplies but lacked water, this natural source was a relief. Suddenly, a cry for help echoed across the island, sending a chill down my spine.
paragraphs.zh: 山顶上的泉水引起了我的注意。与我们在“伊斯帕尼奥拉”号上的小屋相比，虽然物资充足但缺水的问题得到了缓解，这时岛上突然传来求救的喊声，让我不寒而栗。

paragraphs.en: Jim Hawkins had been found dead.
paragraphs.zh: 吉姆·霍金斯已被发现死亡。

paragraphs.en: Having served as both an old soldier and a doctor, I knew time was critical. Without delay, I returned to the shore and boarded the jolly-boat with Hunter. His steady rowing helped us reach the schooner swiftly.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一名既有从军经历又曾是医生的人，我知道时间紧迫。不容迟疑，我返回岸边，与Hunter一起登上了划艇。他平稳的划桨动作让我们迅速接近了那艘帆船。

paragraphs.en: Inside, everyone was shaken. The squire, pale as a sheet, reflected on his misguided actions. One of the forecastle hands was also visibly upset.
paragraphs.zh: 里面众人皆惊，执事骑士面色苍白，回想起自己的不当之举，不禁陷入了沉思。甲板前部的一名水手也显得颇为不安。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett pointed out that if we had moved slightly differently, the fainting man would have fallen into the water. We quickly discussed and planned our response to this sudden development.
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长指出，如果我们稍微移动一下位置，那个晕倒的人就会掉进水里。我们迅速讨论并制定了应对这一突发情况的方案。

paragraphs.en: We placed Redruth in the gallery between the cabin and forecastle, armed with muskets and a mattress. Hunter maneuvered the boat under the stern-port while Joyce and I loaded it with powder tins, muskets, biscuits, pork, cognac, and my medicine chest.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在画廊中安置了瑞德斯廷，将其置于船舱与前桅之间，并配备了步枪和一个床垫。亨特将小艇移至船尾舷窗下方，而乔伊斯和我则往里面装载了火药箱、步枪、饼干、咸肉、白兰地以及我的药箱。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the squire and captain remained on deck. The captain addressed Mr. Hands: "We have two pistols each. Any signal from you six means death."
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，管家和船长仍留在甲板上。船长对汉斯先生说道：“我们每人有两把火枪。你们六人有任何信号，都将意味着死亡。”

paragraphs.en: The seamen were surprised but retreated down the companion ladder, intending to ambush us. However, they saw Redruth waiting in the sparred gallery and quickly changed course.
paragraphs.zh: 水手们虽然感到惊讶，但仍退回到舷梯下方，打算伏击我们。然而，他们发现雷德斯廷正站在桅杆间的甲板上等待着，便迅速改变了计划。

paragraphs.en: "Down, dog!" shouted the captain as a head appeared above deck. The head retracted, and we heard no more from them.
paragraphs.zh: “下去，狗东西！”船长喊道，只见一个人头刚露出甲板。那头又缩了回去，之后便再无动静。

paragraphs.en: By then, we had loaded the jolly-boat with supplies. Joyce and I exited through the stern-port and rowed back to shore as fast as possible.
paragraphs.zh: 到那时，我们已经把小划子装满了补给。乔伊斯和我从艉门出来，尽可能快地划桨返回岸边。

paragraphs.en: This second trip alerted the watchers on land. "Lillibullero" was dropped again. Just before losing sight of them behind a small point, one seaman rushed ashore.
paragraphs.zh: 这次航行再次引起了陆地上的监视者们的注意。“利利bull罗”这个名字又一次被提及。就在船只消失在一个小岬角后，一名水手急忙上了岸。

paragraphs.en: I considered destroying their boats but feared Silver's proximity, risking everything.
paragraphs.zh: 我曾考虑毁掉他们的船只，但担心Silver近在咫尺，一旦暴露计划，一切将化为泡影。

paragraphs.en: We landed in the same spot and began provisioning the block house. All three of us made the first journey, heavily laden, tossing our stores over the palisade. Joyce stayed to guard them while Hunter and I returned to the jolly-boat for another load.
paragraphs.zh: 我们三人同时着陆，开始为木堡准备物资。我们三个都肩负重担，将货物抛过栅栏。Joyce 留下来看守物资，而Hunter和我则返回划艇再去一趟。

paragraphs.en: We continued without pause until all cargo was placed. The servants then guarded the block house as I rowed back to the HISPANIOLA.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不停地忙碌，直到所有的货物都卸载完毕。随后，仆人们守卫着堡垒，而我则划船返回了“希帕尼奥拉”号。

paragraphs.en: The squire, now recovered from his faintness, secured the painter and began loading the boat. We packed it with pork, powder, and biscuits, along with a musket and cutlass for each of us—Redruth, the captain, and myself. The rest of the arms and powder were dropped overboard in two fathoms of water.
paragraphs.zh: 骑士恢复过来后，迅速控制了画家，并开始往船上装载物资。我们把猪肉、火药和饼干装进了船舱，每人还配备了一支步枪和一把砍刀——包括雷德鲁斯船长和我自己。剩下的武器和火药则被丢入了两英尺深的水中。

paragraphs.en: As the tide began to ebb, voices from the direction of the gigs reassured us about Joyce and Hunter's safety. However, it signaled our need to depart quickly. Redruth moved from his gallery position into the boat, which we then positioned near the ship’s counter for easier access by Captain Smollett.
paragraphs.zh: 随着潮水开始退去，来自小艇方向的声音让我们放心，Joyce和Hunter应该安全无恙。但这也意味着我们必须迅速离开。Redruth从他的观察位置移动到小艇上，我们随后将小艇靠近船只的船舷，以便船长Smollett更容易上下船。

paragraphs.en: "Men," called out the captain, "do you hear me?"
paragraphs.zh: “船员们，”船长喊道，“听到没有？”

paragraphs.en: There was no response from the forecastle.
paragraphs.zh: 船首没有传来任何回应。

paragraphs.en: "I am speaking to Abraham Gray," said Mr. Smollett louder. "I am leaving this ship and order you to follow your captain."
paragraphs.zh: “我正在和亚伯拉罕·格雷说话，”斯莫莱特先生提高了声音，“我要离开这艘船，并命令你跟随你的船长。”

paragraphs.en: Gray remained silent.
paragraphs.zh: 格雷默然不语。

paragraphs.en: "Gray," continued the captain, raising his voice further, "I have my watch in hand; I give you thirty seconds to join me."
paragraphs.zh: “格雷，”船长提高嗓门继续说道，“我手里有手表；给你三十秒的时间跟我一起去。”

paragraphs.en: A moment of silence followed.
paragraphs.zh: 片刻沉默。

paragraphs.en: "Come, my fine fellow," urged the captain, "don't hang so long. I am risking my life and these gentlemen's lives every second."
paragraphs.zh: “来吧，我的好伙计，”船长催促道，“别再犹豫了。我可是每秒都在冒着生命危险，包括这些先生们的生命。”

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, there was a scuffle, then a sound of blows. Abraham Gray emerged with a knife cut on his cheek, running to the captain like a dog to its master.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，一阵打斗声传来，紧接着是拳脚交加的声音。亚伯拉罕·格雷带着脸颊上的刀伤跑了出来，像条狗见到主人一样奔向船长。

paragraphs.en: "I'm with you, sir," he said.
paragraphs.zh: “我跟你一起去，先生。”他说。

paragraphs.en: In an instant, Gray and the captain boarded our boat, and we pushed off, rowing away from the ship but not yet reaching our stockade ashore.
paragraphs.zh: 瞬间，格雷和船长登上了我们的小艇，我们划桨离开了大船，但还没有抵达岸上的营寨。
